name: Interleaver Benchmark Suite
description: Campaign data behind the paper. Eight sweeps: four burst regimes (single, multi, Gilbert–Elliott e_B = 1.00, Gilbert–Elliott e_B = 0.70) on each of two length grids (common: 50 lengths; standards: the eight IEEE 802.16 ARP block sizes). Each sweep visits every length at five noise targets, with 35 Monte Carlo runs per cell, yielding 1.02 million trial records, of which 0.94 million are within the scope of the validation. The archive contains the per-trial KPI tables from which every number in the paper is computed, in both MATLAB tables and gzip CSV, along with the per-sweep configurations and the standardization constants. The raw simulation state (43 GB) is not archived and is available from the author on request.Supports: R. T. Sirmen, “Code-Aware Interleaver Metrics for Burst-Error Channels: Taxonomy and Validation on a Provenance-Governed Benchmark,” 2026.
